Hi everyone! I opened https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/13176 to propose Image Preview: a way to provide lightweight previews while images load, with the browser managing their display and replacement.

The explainer (https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/MSEdgeExplainers/blob/main/ImagePreview/explainer.md) covers the API and examples. I’d love your feedback on the approach, use cases, and any concerns!
zcorpan Noam Rosenthal replied to the fetch feedback.
